+    {T : Submodule K Y.functionField} (hT : T = divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤) :
+    ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 := by
+  have hn2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D ≤ 2 * (n : ℤ) := by omega
+  have hrank : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) : ℤ)
+      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D
+        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
+    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D hn2),
+      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
+  rw [hχ, hdeg] at hrank
+  have hfr : Module.finrank K ↥T = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) := by
+    rw [hT]
+    exact finrank_divisorSections_top K _
+  refine Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (fun hbot => ?_)
+  rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfr
+  have hcast : (gamma : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hgamma
+  omega
+
 /-- **Uniqueness of an effective degree-`g` divisor from its window section space** (the
 field-level heart of Task 6, family-free): under the pinch pack, two effective
 degree-`g` divisors with the same window section space `H⁰(𝒪(N − ·))` coincide — both
 are presented as the base divisor of the common section space
 (`baseDivisorAt_window_normalization`), which is a function of that space alone. -/
 theorem eq_of_divisorSections_window_eq (g : ℕ)
     (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
     (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
     (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
     (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
       Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
     (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
     (D D' : Y.CurveDivisor)
     (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ))
     (hD'0 : 0 ≤ D') (hdeg' : CurveDivisor.deg K D' = (g : ℤ))
     (h : divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤ = divisorSections K (N - D') ⊤) :
     D = D' := by
   refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
   rw [← baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D hD0 hdeg hx,
     ← baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D' hD'0 hdeg' hx, h]

  "body": "A "STRICTLY WEAKER REDUCTION" CAN BE INTERDERIVABLE AT THE VERY SITE YOU RECOMMEND IT FOR -- and neither endpoint of the abstract statement shows it.

WHAT HAPPENED (AJC, Picard/DivSupportQuasiFinite.lean, run 0095 r5, three commits in ~20 minutes). A lane landed three reductions of one instance binder and ranked them by hypothesis strength: two point-set forms needing HasProperSupport, and a fibrewise form (via mathlib's LocallyQuasiFinite.of_fiberToSpecResidueField) advertised as "STRICTLY WEAKER in hypotheses ... it applies to a module with no properness assumption whatever". A whole commit plus two docstring sections tell a future producer to aim at the fibrewise one.

The strength ordering is TRUE for an arbitrary module. It is EMPTY at the recommended site. Probed both directions AT A DivFamily, where properSupport is a structure field:
- fibrewise antecedent gives the point-set antecedent (compose the new of_fibers with the new iff);
- point-set antecedent gives the fibrewise one (of_finite_preimage_singleton, then the ambient IsProper from the field, then inferInstance per fibre).
Both close. So at the only place a producer will ever stand, the three differently-priced antecedents are ONE antecedent, and the third commit bought a spelling.

THE GENERALISABLE TELL: a hypothesis-strength claim is about a lemma's BINDER LIST; the advice built on it is about a SITE. Whenever the site supplies the binder that separates the forms -- here properSupport as a field -- the separation collapses there, and the collapse is invisible from either end of the abstract statement. Before publishing "aim at the weaker form", instantiate BOTH at the consumer and derive each from the other. If both close, say so: the remaining choice is which shape the argument naturally produces, a real but much smaller claim.

RELATED, same file, same session: it also claimed two binders were "FREE from properSupport ... by synthesis". They are structure-parent projections (IsProper extends LocallyOfFiniteType; UniversallyClosed gives QuasiCompact at priority 900). "Free by synthesis" and "is a parent field of the hypothesis" read identically in a docstring and price very differently.",

data.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
paths=(
  .archon-horizon/inbox/local/history/I-1812.jsonl
  .archon-horizon/inbox/local/items/I-1812.yaml
)
expected=$(printf "%s'"\\n\" \""'${paths[@]}" | sort)
ref=$("$HORIZON_GIT" symbolic-ref -q HEAD)
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5
do
  old=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
  idx=$(mktemp /tmp/rev2-ajcr-index.XXXXXX)
  rm -f "$idx"
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$old"
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" add -- "${paths[@]}"
  actual=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-only "$old" | sort)
  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
    printf "unexpected staged paths:'"\\n%s\\n\" \""'$actual" >&2
    rm -f "$idx"
    exit 1
  fi
  printf "PRE-COMMIT NAME-STATUS (attempt %s, parent %s)'"\\n\" \""'$attempt" "$old"
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-status "$old"
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --shortstat "$old"
  tree=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" write-tree)
  rm -f "$idx"
  new=$(printf "%s'"\\n\\n%s\\n\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n\" \\
    \"chore(review): guard the AJCR integration boundary\" \\
    \"Summary: **Coordination.** Records the parameter-lane checkpoint request so reviewer integration cannot silently publish unverified tower files.\" \\
    \"Archon-Commit: agent\" \\
    \"Archon-Run: "'$ARCHON_HORIZON_RUN" '"\\
    \"Archon-Role: "'$ARCHON_HORIZON_AGENT_ROLE" '"\\
    \"Archon-Session: "'$ARCHON_HORIZON_SESSION" '"\\
    \"Archon-Task: "'$ARCHON_HORIZON_TASK" '"\\
    \"Archon-Projects: "'$ARCHON_HORIZON_PROJECTS" '"\\
    \"\" | \""'$HORIZON_GIT" -c user.name="Archon Horizon" -c user.email="archon-horizon@local" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$old")
  if "$HORIZON_GIT" update-ref "$ref" "$new" "$old" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf "COMMIT %s'"\\n\" \""'$new"
    post=$("$HORIZON_GIT" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$old" "$new" | sort)
    if [ "$post" != "$expected" ]; then
      printf "unexpected post-commit paths:'"\\n%s\\n\" \""'$post" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    "$HORIZON_GIT" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r "$old" "$new"
    "$HORIZON_GIT" diff-tree --shortstat "$old" "$new"
    "$HORIZON_GIT" show -s --format="%s" "$new"
    for path in "${paths[@]}"; do
      "$HORIZON_GIT" show "$new:$path" | cmp -s - "$path"
    done
    exit 0
  fi
  printf "CAS retry %s: HEAD advanced'"\\n\" \""'$attempt" >&2
done
printf "CAS failed after five attempts'"\\n\" >&2
exit 1"
